```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(sf)
library(tmap)

## Census Data

age_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_age.csv")
age_sex_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_age_sex.csv")
disability_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_disability.csv")
disability_sex_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_disability_sex.csv")
education_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_education.csv")
education_sex_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_education_sex.csv")
ethnicity_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_ethnicity.csv")
ethnicity_sex_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_ethnicity_sex.csv")

## Crime Data
crime_data_street_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_street.csv")
crime_data_stopandsearch_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_stopandsearch.csv")
crime_data_outcomes_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_outcomes.csv")

crime_data_street_hastings$Month<-as.Date(paste(crime_data_street_hastings$Month, "-01", sep=""))
crime_data_stopandsearch_hastings$Date<-as.POSIXct(crime_data_stopandsearch_hastings$Date)

## IMD Data

hastings_shape<-read_sf( "../Shapefiles/Hastings_LSOAs.shp")
IMD_hastings<-read.csv("../Data for Explainer Pack/hastings_IMD.csv")

hastings_shape<-cbind(hastings_shape,IMD_hastings)

```

## 2021 Census Data


```{r,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

age_sex_hastings_total<-age_sex_hastings |> group_by(Sex..2.categories.,Age..6.categories.) |> 
  summarise(total=sum(Observation))

ggplot(age_sex_hastings_total)+
  geom_linerange(aes(x = Age..6.categories., ymin = 0, ymax = total, colour = Sex..2.categories.), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 1))+
  geom_point(aes(x = Age..6.categories., y = total, colour = Sex..2.categories.),
             position = position_dodge(width = 1))+
  coord_flip()

```


```{r,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

ethnicity_sex_hastings_total<-ethnicity_sex_hastings |> group_by(Sex..2.categories.,Ethnic.group..20.categories.) |>

                 position = position_dodge(width = 1))+
  geom_point(aes(x = Ethnic.group..20.categories., y = total, colour = Sex..2.categories.),
             position = position_dodge(width = 1))+
  coord_flip()

```

```{r, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}

  ggplot(aes(x=Crime.type,y=n))+geom_bar(stat = "identity")+
  coord_flip()

```

```{r, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}

crime_data_street_hastings |> group_by(Month) |> count() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Month,y=n))+geom_line()

```

```{r, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}

```
